SchemeSummary.Fund_Type: An open ended equity investment strategy investing in listed equity and equity related instruments including limited short exposure in equity through derivative instruments
SchemeSummary.Description_Objective_of_the_scheme: To generate long-term capital appreciation by investing in a diversified portfolio of equity and equity-related instruments while utilizing limited short exposure through derivatives. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Investment strategy will be achieved.
